description: Broadcasts when a signer is configured. Sends the TxPayload fields from any dexe_*_build_* tool and waits for confirmation. Pass `chainId` when several chains are configured, plus the payload's own chainId as `payloadChainId` — a mismatch REFUSES the send. Calldata with a privileged GovUserKeeper accounting selector is refused (hard block, no override).

chainId.description: Chain to broadcast on; needs an RPC for it. Default: the MCP's default chain.

payload.description: A dexe_*_build_* `payload` object verbatim ({to,data,value,chainId}). Fills to/data/value and payloadChainId when the flat fields are omitted.

chainId.description: The payload's own chainId; used as payloadChainId

value.description: Wei value as decimal string (the payload's `value`, default 0)

payloadChainId.description: The TxPayload's own `chainId`, copied verbatim — a mismatch REFUSES the send.

signerKey.description: Signer: omit = primary DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY (never an agent); 'agent<n>'/address = keyring.

to.description: Destination contract address (or pass the builder's `payload` object)

name: dexe_tx_send
title: Sign and broadcast a transaction
